purpose: Verify that a collaborating reviewer retained the deterministic governance context without relying on unstated assumptions.
question_ar: ما نتيجة اختبار GH-02 محلياً، وأين سجلت الحالات السلبية، وما الملاحظة الحرجة في deterministic-gate.yml قبل تحويله إلى Required Check؟
acceptance_rule: All three expected assertions must be present in a bounded answer. Any missing or ambiguous assertion is recorded as hold: verification_incomplete.
non_goals: This test does not authorize an external action.
This test does not prove cryptographic identity of the responder.
This test does not replace a human approval.
